candidates.title: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
candidates.finding: OpenAI and Ironclad experts identified 11 legal, commercial and procurement tasks; each was evaluated against 8–50 task-specific criteria. Ironclad provided hosted practice environments, and researchers created synthetic training tasks around representative workflows for reinforcement-learning practice and feedback. The synthetic tasks used public SEC EDGAR contracts with personal-information filtering, not customer/private Ironclad or OpenAI contract data. Reported task times are simulated estimates, not observed customer time savings.
candidates.hilo_adaptation: Propose development-only expert-designed robotics task rubrics, environment-specific pass/fail criteria, and clearly labeled synthetic practice tasks that are evaluated separately from preregistered holdouts and real-world field trials. Preserve source provenance, permission and privacy review; do not infer field hours, human keep votes, safety certification, real task-time savings, or any OpenAI/Ironclad affiliation from synthetic results.

reviewed_not_admitted.title: OpenAI research index — October 7 GPT-6 UI/product and October 6 mathematics research
reviewed_not_admitted.reason: The Oct 7 product and safety releases and Oct 6 mathematics work do not add a distinct demonstrations, robot-data, video-labeling, domain-randomization, human-preference or longitudinal field-evaluation method applicable to HILO beyond current sources. Targeted Stanford/Harvard/Oxford review did not establish a separate new primary-method candidate today.
